title: Seçtiğin aile

characters.FRIEND1: a young woman of about twenty-eight with straight black hair, wearing a yellow raincoat
characters.FRIEND2: a young woman of about twenty-eight with short curly blond hair, wearing a wine red coat

scenes.text:
Kötü haberi ilk kime söylüyorsan,
aslında ailen odur.
scenes.prompt: On a rainy night, {FRIEND1} sits alone on the steps of an apartment building with her head down, rain falling, a glowing street lamp, puddles on the pavement.

scenes.text:
Aranızda kan bağı yok,
ama sesinden ne olduğunu anlar.
scenes.prompt: On a bench in an autumn park, {FRIEND2} on the right turns toward {FRIEND1} on the left with a caring, worried face, golden leaves falling around them.

scenes.text:
Gece yarısı arasan da
"Neredesin, geliyorum" der.
scenes.prompt: On a rainy night street, {FRIEND2} hurries across the wet road under an open umbrella toward a lit apartment building, street lamps reflecting in the puddles.

scenes.text:
Doğduğun aileyi sen seçmedin;
onu ise sen seçtin.
scenes.prompt: In a small cozy kitchen at night, {FRIEND1} on the left smiles through tears and {FRIEND2} on the right smiles back, two cups of tea and a glowing candle on the table, rain on the window.

scenes.text:
Ve o da seni her gün yeniden seçiyor.
Bunu ona gönder.
scenes.prompt: At sunset on an autumn path, {FRIEND1} and {FRIEND2} walk side by side laughing, seen from behind, golden leaves falling around them.

caption:
Aklına kim geldi?

Kan bağı olmayan aile de ailedir. 🤍

Bunu ona gönder.
